description: This file defines authentication-related route handlers for a Node.js Express backend, including user registration, login, and retrieval of current user info.

methods.name: POST /auth/register
methods.description: Handles user registration; creates a new user and logs the activity.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Handles user login; verifies credentials and logs the activity.

methods.name: GET /auth/me
methods.description: Retrieves current user information based on the authentication token.
